gloss: headship of a family (with its estate)

definitions.gloss: headship of a family, with its estate
definitions.explanation: Under Japan's old family system, the position of head of the household together with its property, normally passed to the eldest son. The system was abolished after the Second World War.

examples.japanese: {家督|かとく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: Succeed to the headship of the family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{家督|かとく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The eldest son inherited the headship of the family.

notes:
USAGE:
- A historical word, met in history books, period dramas and novels, and sometimes said of an old family business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家督|かとく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧: to succeed as head of the family

- {家督|かとく}⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧: succession to the headship (the prewar legal system)
